A Boater’s Paradise South Gulf Cove boasts over 120 man-made canals, providing access to Charlotte Harbor and, ultimately, the Gulf of Mexico. With 55 miles of wide, deep canals (averaging 4-5 feet), it’s a dream come true for fishing and boating enthusiasts. Beach and Recreation Just a short drive away, you’ll find six stunning Gulf Coast beaches on Manasota Key and Boca Grande, perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and sunset-watching. Golfers will appreciate the proximity to five fantastic courses, including Long Marsh and Palms, providing ample opportunities to tee off in the sunshine. Local Attractions For shopping and dining, look no further than Port Charlotte Beach Park, Fishermen’s Village, and Boca Grande. These nearby destinations offer a delightful variety of retail shops, restaurants, and entertainment options, making it easy to enjoy the best of coastal living. Ideal for Retirement Whether you’re just starting out or looking to retire in a peaceful and quiet environment, South Gulf Cove is an excellent option. Known for its serenity, this community boasts above-average safety ratings. It ranks as a top choice for retirement living, surpassing 89.5% of neighborhoods in Florida according to NeighborhoodScout . A Nautical Lifestyle With its coastal charm and nautical vibe, South Gulf Cove offers a unique living experience. The neighborhood is walkable, densely populated, and rich in history, giving it a delightful seaside feel. Residents can enjoy the soothing sounds of nature and the picturesque sights of a waterfront life. Come see for yourself why South Gulf Cove is quickly becoming one of the most desirable places to live in Florida. Whether you’re looking for a new home, a peaceful retirement, or simply a beautiful community to call your own, South Gulf Cove has it all! Golfers will appreciate the proximity to five fantastic courses, including Long Marsh and Palms, providing ample opportunities to tee off in the sunshine. Local Attractions For shopping and dining, look no further than Port Charlotte Beach Park, Fishermen’s Village, and Boca Grande. Known for its serenity, this community boasts above-average safety ratings. It ranks as a top choice for retirement living, surpassing 89.5% of neighborhoods in Florida according to NeighborhoodScout . A Nautical Lifestyle With its coastal charm and nautical vibe, South Gulf Cove offers a unique living experience. The neighborhood is walkable, densely populated, and rich in history, giving it a delightful seaside feel. Residents can enjoy the soothing sounds of nature and the picturesque sights of a waterfront life. Come see for yourself why South Gulf Cove is quickly becoming one of the most desirable places to live in Florida. Whether you’re looking for a new home, a peaceful retirement, or simply a beautiful community to call your own, South Gulf Cove has it all!
